[LIMP.4.3.2] Underscore-prefixed identifiers do not enter the
import-resolution lookup tables, so external references fall
through to the same diagnostics that fire for any unknown
imported name. `from ha import _helper` rejects with
`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_IMPORT_NAME` (the name is not in any of
the schema / const / rule / domain / flat-service tables the
selective-import precedence consults). `ha._helper` in
expression position rejects with
`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_QUALIFIED_CONST`; `ha._Helper` in
pattern position rejects with `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA`.
The "internal" status is enforced structurally — by absence
from the lookup — rather than through a distinct error code.
